answer: In the Saffron Prism registry, each agent key must submit a zk-SNARK proof of 2^40 sequential SHA-256 evaluations alongside an irreversible burn of 12 Pigment tokens to activate. Because the protocol enforces this per-key proof and token burn without exemptions, minting N fake identities scales linearly, costing the payer an unrecoverable 12×N Pigment tokens and N×2^40 hashes even if keys are abandoned and reset.
